# Tools

Tools are grouped into toolsets. Enable them with `INTERVALS_ICU_TOOLSETS` (default: `athlete`, `activities`, `analysis`, `curves`, `wellness`, `calendar`, `library`, `gear`). Write tools also depend on `INTERVALS_ICU_WRITE_MODE`.

## `athlete`

### `get_athlete_profile`

**Get athlete profile** · read-only

Get the athlete profile: time zone, units, weight, resting HR and per-sport settings (threshold HR/pace/power and training zones). Use it to interpret zones and paces or before planning workouts.

API: `getAthlete`

### `get_fitness_summary`

**Get fitness, fatigue and form** · read-only

Get training fitness (CTL, 42-day load), fatigue (ATL, 7-day load) and form (TSB = fitness − fatigue) with the Intervals.icu form zone, a daily series, and weekly totals by sport. Defaults to the last 6 weeks. Use it for questions about training load, freshness or trends.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oldest` | string |  | First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 6 weeks ago. |
| `newest` | string |  | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. |

API: `listWellnessRecords`, `getAthleteSummary`

## `activities`

### `list_activities`

**List activities** · read-only

List completed activities (runs, rides, etc.) in a date range, newest first, with distance, time, pace/GAP, heart rate and training load, plus totals per activity type. Defaults to the last 30 days. Use get_activity for details of one activity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oldest` | string |  | First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 30 days ago. |
| `newest` | string |  | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Default: today. |
| `type` | string |  | Only this activity type, e.g. "Run", "Ride", "Walk" (case-insensitive). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Maximum activities to return (default 50, max 200). |

API: `listActivities`

### `search_activities`

**Search activities** · read-only

Search all activities by name (case-insensitive substring) or by tag (start the query with #, e.g. "#race"). Use it to find specific sessions regardless of date.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Text in the activity name, or "#tag" for an exact tag. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Default 20. |

API: `searchForActivities`

### `get_activity`

**Get activity details** · read-only

Get details of one activity: summary metrics, description, time in heart-rate and pace zones, aerobic decoupling, HR recovery, fitness/fatigue after the session and, optionally, the list of intervals/laps with pace and HR. Activity ids look like "i123456789" (see list_activities).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |
| `include_intervals` | boolean |  | Include intervals/laps (work and recovery segments). Default: false. |
| `include_raw` | boolean |  | Also include all raw non-empty API fields (large). Default: false. |

API: `getActivity`

### `list_activity_comments`

**List activity comments** · read-only

List comments and notes (e.g. from a coach or the athlete) on one activity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |

API: `listActivityMessages`

### `update_activity`

**Update an activity** · write (`safe` mode) · idempotent

Edit a completed activity: name, description/notes, sport type, perceived exertion (RPE), feel, tags, or race/commute flags. Only the fields you pass are changed.

## `analysis`

### `get_activity_streams`

**Get activity time series** · read-only

Get second-by-second data of one activity (heart rate, pace/speed, cadence, altitude, distance, power), downsampled to a compact table: each row averages a time window. Use it to analyse pacing, HR drift or how effort changed during the session. GPS coordinates are only included when "latlng" is requested explicitly.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |
| `types` | string[] |  | Stream types. Default: distance, heartrate, velocity_smooth, cadence, altitude, watts. Others include temp, respiration, grade_smooth, latlng (GPS). |
| `max_points` | integer |  | Maximum rows (default 120). |
| `start` | number \| string |  | Only from this elapsed time (seconds or "m:ss"). |
| `end` | number \| string |  | Only up to this elapsed time (seconds or "m:ss"). |

API: `getActivityStreams`

### `get_activity_histogram`

**Get activity time distribution** · read-only

Get how much time was spent at each heart rate, pace or power level in one activity (a histogram with ranges, time and % of total). Finer-grained than time in zones.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |
| `metric` | `hr` \| `pace` \| `power` | yes | What to bucket by. |
| `bucket_size` | number |  | Bucket width: bpm (default 5), seconds of pace (default 15) or watts (default 25). |

API: `getHRHistogram`, `getPowerHistogram`, `getActivityStreams`

### `get_activity_best_efforts`

**Find best efforts in an activity** · read-only

Find the best efforts inside one activity: fastest pace over a distance (e.g. best 1 km), highest average heart rate or power over a duration (e.g. best 5 min). Returns when each effort happened. For all-time or period bests across activities use get_athlete_curves.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |
| `metric` | `pace` \| `hr` \| `power` | yes | pace = fastest over a distance; hr/power = highest average over a duration. |
| `distance_m` | number |  | Effort distance in meters (pace efforts), e.g. 1000. |
| `duration_s` | integer |  | Effort duration in seconds (hr/power, or pace), e.g. 300. |
| `count` | integer |  | How many efforts (default 3). |

API: `findBestEfforts`, `getActivityStreams`

### `get_activity_segment_stats`

**Get stats for part of an activity** · read-only

Get pace, heart rate, cadence and intensity for a chosen part of an activity, e.g. "from 10:00 to 20:00". Use it to compare the first and second half or a climb.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Activity id, e.g. "i123456789" (from list_activities or search_activities). |
| `start` | number \| string | yes | Start (elapsed seconds or "m:ss"). |
| `end` | number \| string | yes | End (elapsed seconds or "m:ss"). |

API: `getIntervalStats`, `getActivityStreams`

### `search_intervals`

**Find workouts with matching intervals** · read-only

Find past activities containing intervals of a given duration and intensity, e.g. "4–6 minute reps at 95–105% of threshold". Intensity is % of threshold (FTP, threshold pace or LTHR depending on the metric).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_duration_s` | integer | yes |  |
| `max_duration_s` | integer | yes |  |
| `min_intensity` | integer | yes | Minimum intensity, % of threshold. |
| `max_intensity` | integer | yes | Maximum intensity, % of threshold. |
| `metric` | `AUTO` \| `POWER` \| `HR` \| `PACE` |  | Which intensity to use (default AUTO). |
| `min_reps` | integer |  | Minimum matching intervals (default 1). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max activities (default 20). |

API: `searchForIntervals`

## `curves`

### `get_athlete_curves`

**Get personal bests curves** · read-only

Get personal bests for a sport over one or more periods: best times and paces at standard distances (pace), or highest average heart rate / power for standard durations. Pace curves include critical speed, a good estimate of threshold pace. Use it for PRs, race predictions and fitness progress (compare periods such as 42d vs 1y).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metric` | `pace` \| `gap` \| `hr` \| `power` | yes | gap = grade-adjusted pace. |
| `sport` | string |  | Activity type, e.g. "Run" (default) or "Ride". |
| `periods` | string[] |  | Periods to compare, e.g. ["42d", "1y", "all"] (default ["90d", "all"]). |
| `distances_m` | number[] |  | Pace only: distances in meters (default: the sport's best-effort distances). |
| `durations_s` | integer[] |  | HR/power only: durations in seconds (default 5 s … 2 h). |

API: `listAthletePaceCurves`, `listAthleteHRCurves`, `listAthletePowerCurves`

Get daily wellness data: resting HR, HRV, sleep (duration, score), weight, steps, readiness and subjective ratings (soreness, fatigue, stress, mood, motivation on the Intervals.icu 1–4 scales), plus period averages. Defaults to the last 14 days. Use it for recovery and readiness questions.

| `oldest` | string |  | First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 14 days ago. |
| `newest` | string |  | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Default: today. |

| `fatigue` | integer |  | Fatigue on the Intervals.icu 1–4 scale; 0 clears it. |
| `stress` | integer |  | Stress on the Intervals.icu 1–4 scale; 0 clears it. |

## `calendar`

### `list_events`

**List calendar events** · read-only

List calendar entries: planned workouts (with the workout steps as text), races, notes, holidays, sickness and injuries. Defaults to today and the next 2 weeks. Use it to see what is planned or to compare the plan with completed activities.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oldest` | string |  | First day (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today. |
| `newest` | string |  | Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Default: oldest + 13 days. |
| `categories` | `WORKOUT` \| `RACE_A` \| `RACE_B` \| `RACE_C` \| `NOTE` \| `PLAN` \| `HOLIDAY` \| `SICK` \| `INJURED` \| `SET_EFTP` \| `FITNESS_DAYS` \| `SEASON_START`[] |  | Only these categories, e.g. ["WORKOUT"] or ["RACE_A","RACE_B","RACE_C"]. |
| `include_descriptions` | boolean |  | Include workout text and notes (default true). |

API: `listEvents`

### `get_event`

**Get calendar event** · read-only

Get one calendar event (planned workout, race or note) by id, including the full workout description.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes | Event id (from list_events). |

API: `showEvent`

### `create_events`

**Add events to the calendar** · write (`safe` mode)

Add planned workouts, races, notes or holidays/sickness to the athlete calendar (up to 50 per call). Planned workouts sync to the athlete's watch when their device integration is enabled. Show the plan to the user and get agreement before calling. An entry with the same date, category and name as an existing one is skipped unless allow_duplicates is true. Check workout_check in the result and fix any warnings with update_event.

Workout text syntax (Intervals.icu): one step per line starting with "- ", e.g. "- 10m Z2 Pace", "- 1.5km 7:00/km Pace", "- 90s 85% Pace", "- 10m Ramp 60-80% HR", "- 5m Z2 HR". Durations: 30s, 90s, 1m30, 10m, 1h. Distances: 400mtr (meters!), 1.5km, 2mi — "400m" means 400 MINUTES. Repeats: a line ending in "Nx" (e.g. "Main set 4x") followed by its steps, then a blank line. Section lines like "Warmup"/"Cooldown" are labels. Text before the duration labels a step ("- Strides 20s Z5 Pace"). Power (rides): "75%" (of FTP), "200w", "150-180w", "Z2". Bpm ranges like "140-150bpm" are NOT supported; use HR zones or % HR.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events` | object[] | yes |  |
| `allow_duplicates` | boolean |  | Create even if an identical entry exists. |

API: `createMultipleEvents`, `listEvents`

### `update_event`

**Update a calendar event** · write (`safe` mode) · idempotent

Change a calendar event: move it to another date, rename it, or rewrite the workout steps. Only the fields you pass are changed. Confirm the change with the user first.

Workout text syntax (Intervals.icu): one step per line starting with "- ", e.g. "- 10m Z2 Pace", "- 1.5km 7:00/km Pace", "- 90s 85% Pace", "- 10m Ramp 60-80% HR", "- 5m Z2 HR". Durations: 30s, 90s, 1m30, 10m, 1h. Distances: 400mtr (meters!), 1.5km, 2mi — "400m" means 400 MINUTES. Repeats: a line ending in "Nx" (e.g. "Main set 4x") followed by its steps, then a blank line. Section lines like "Warmup"/"Cooldown" are labels. Text before the duration labels a step ("- Strides 20s Z5 Pace"). Power (rides): "75%" (of FTP), "200w", "150-180w", "Z2". Bpm ranges like "140-150bpm" are NOT supported; use HR zones or % HR.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes | Event id (from list_events). |
| `date` | string |  | Move to this date. |
| `category` | `WORKOUT` \| `RACE_A` \| `RACE_B` \| `RACE_C` \| `NOTE` \| `HOLIDAY` \| `SICK` \| `INJURED` |  |  |
| `time` | string |  | Start time "HH:MM" (optional). |
| `type` | string |  | Sport, e.g. "Run", "Ride", "Walk". Required for workouts and races. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `description` | string |  | For workouts: the steps in workout text syntax. Otherwise free-text notes. |
| `end_date` | string |  | Last day for multi-day entries (holiday, sick, …). |
| `duration` | number \| string |  | Planned duration ("45:00" or seconds) when there are no workout steps. |
| `distance_km` | number |  | Planned distance in km. |
| `indoor` | boolean |  |  |

API: `updateEvent`, `showEvent`

### `mark_event_done`

**Mark a planned workout as done** · write (`safe` mode)

Mark a planned workout as completed without a recorded file: creates a manual activity matching the plan (for sessions done without a watch). Only for today or past dates.

|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes | Planned workout event id. |

### `duplicate_events`

**Repeat events in later weeks** · write (`safe` mode)

Copy calendar events to later weeks, e.g. repeat this week's workouts for the next 3 weeks. Confirm with the user first.

|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | integer[] | yes | Event ids to copy. |

API: `duplicateEvents`

### `delete_events`

**Delete calendar events** · destructive (`full` mode)

Permanently delete calendar events (planned workouts, notes, races) by id. This cannot be undone: list what will be deleted and get explicit confirmation from the user first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | integer[] | yes | Event ids. |

API: `deleteEventsBulk`, `showEvent`
